name: Stead farm upgrade with public token sweep
summary: Ten seconds before the exploit the Stead deployer upgraded the farm proxy to an implementation whose function 0x16fb27ce looks up the SteadToken entry in its registry and transfers the farm's whole balance to msg.sender, without any access check. A generic MEV bot called it, took the farm's 135,000 STEAD and sold them through the STEAD/USD0 and USD0/WETH pools.
notes: The upgrade by the project's deployer 0xfa3c1081 is a privileged action that installed the vulnerable code, so it is the reset (rule 1); the exploiting bot 0x5fb0b858 (over 10,000 transactions through its executor 0x34c7c354, created in February 2025) is unrelated to it. A second caller of 0x16fb27ce (ref) found the farm empty.
STEAD has no DefiLlama price; it is valued at the 14,484.88 USD0 its sale realised (rule 12).
